buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic OPTION CLAUSE 50% : The buyer can increase or decrease the contract quantity or contract duration up to 50 percent at the time of issue of the contract. However, once the contract is issued, the contract quantity or contract duration can only be increased up to 50 percent. Bidders are bound to accept the revised quantity or duration. For lumpsum-based service contracts, the buyer may increase the scope of work and contract value up to 50 percent with the consent of the service provider 2. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC

Buyer Added text based ATC clauses ADDITIONAL TERMS AND CONDITIONS 1. SR.DY. IFA (AF) 32 WING, JODHPUR as buyer is interested in ‘Outsourcin g of Manpower (Conservancy) Services’ employing unskilled manpower for offic e uses (cleaning/housekeeping) in the premises of SR.DY. IFA (AF) 32 WING, JO DHPUR. 2. Scope of services expected to be provided by the contractor within the premises for upkeep & maintenance of office are given below. a. Keeping the office in an organized manner. b. Cleaning and maintaining hygiene in all the rooms and premises of SR.DY. IFA(AF) 32 WING Sweeping, cleaning and mopping of all roo ms, common area and surrounding things c. Prepare fresh Tea, Coffee for office staff and all work related to ho usekeeping staff/peon. d. Make all necessary arrangements in case of a meeting of higher a uthorities e. Keep record of all the materials/items provided by office to use in premises 3 . Eight working hours (excluding lunch hours) is to be observed for providi ng daily/on-demand basis services as above, the services may have to be provi ded on Sunday/Public holidays also, if required & necessitated by Office of the S R.DY. IFA (AF) 32 WING, JODHPUR. 4. Though the Bid is for providing outsources services through the contract or, the contractor shall have to ensure that the minimum rates of wages as pro mulgated by the Government of India, Ministry of Labour & Employment office o f the Chief Labour Commissioner, will be applicable on the date of entering in to this agreement failing which the contractor will be held responsible and will be penalized. To ensure the same, payment to the labourers/workmen will have to be made only in their personal account through nationalized banks. 5. The Bid form should be signed by the proprietor/Partner of the firm or by a person digitally along with the signed scanned and original copy of the same who is duly authorized and legally competent to do so. A person signing the for ms or any document forming part of the contract on behalf of the firm shall be d eemed to have been duly authorized by the Proprietor/partner of the firm and a ctions taken by such person in pursuance of this contract shall be deemed to ha ve been taken by the proprietor/partner. 6. If any Bidder withdraws his Bid within the validity period or makes any modifications in the terms and conditions of the Bid, which is not acceptable to the Government bid security will be forfeited.

7. Antecedents of the workmen: The contractor shall ensure that the a ntecedents of the workmen reporting for duty are verified by the police and the same should be submitted to this office prior to their deployment for duty. The workmen should be of good character honest sincere and neat & clean, the cont ractor shall be responsible for the discipline and behavior of workmen deployed by them. The contractor will train the workmen on the courtesy to be extended to the user. 8. The contractor will ensure that his employees employed inside Area Acco unts Office (Army), Jodhpur premises have valid identity cards which shall be pr ominently displayed and visible while working/staving inside the premises. The contractor shall also ensure that the manpower employed by him, do not use m obile phones during the work. 9. Workers involved in the services contract will be paid wages as per prev ailing rate of minimum wages of respective schedule according to their skill cat egory rates issued by central Labour Commissioner (New Delhi), Ministry of Lab our and Employment. 10. The contractor also has to abide by the provisions of the Child Labour (P rohibition and Regulation) Act and arrange such facilities for the health and welf are of the labour employed on work. 11. The contractor has to agree to indemnify the government against all clai ms for compensation by or on workman employed by him in connection with thi s agreement for injury or death by accident under the workman's compensation act (Act viii of 1923). 12. Eligibility Criteria: Firms fulfilling the following criteria which are mandat ory will be eligible for consideration:- 12.1. Vendor should have office located in Rajasthan. 12.2. ESIC Registration Certificate: Attested copies of ESIC (E mployees' State Insurance Corporation) Registration Certificate and challa n pertaining to the month prior to the date of publishing of bid. 12.3. EPF Registration Certificate: Attested copy of EPF registration c ertificate and challan pertaining to the month prior to the date of publishing of bid. 12.4. GST Certificate: Attested copies of GST registration certificate and challan for last month. 12.5. PAN Card: Firm should have valid PAN card in the name of firm or in the name of proprietor of the firm in case of proprietor firm (copy to be en closed). 12.6. Firm must be registered with the Ministry of Labour for hiring of labo urers and copy of registration certificate is to be attached 12.7. Certificate duly signed for acceptance of additional terms and conditions of corrigendum (ATC).

12.8. A self-certified certificate, issued within last 10 days of bid publishin g date, stating that company is not black listed by any government agenc y and agency should not have any court proceeding pending for financial embezzlement, fraud, insolvency, bankruptcy (OFF/ON any Director/Partn er/Proprietor) to be uploaded 13. As per Gol MoF OM No. F-9/4/2020-PPD dated 12 Nov 2020, Self Declarat ion certificate in lieu of EMD is to be provided. 14. The firm should have minimum average turnover of ₹25,00,000/- in last three financial years. Turnover Certificate for last three financial years from the date of Opening Bid (audited by Chartered Accountant) is to be provided. 15. The firm should have experience of providing similar services in past thr ee financial years. Contract award documents of successfully completed / ongoi ng contract shall be submitted as documentary evidence. 16. Tie Braking Criteria: In case of tie for L-1. Auto Run L-1 will be applied and the L-1 vendor will be selected by GeM system itself. 17. GeM Contract Conditions for Removal of Outsourcing Staff: 17.1. Unsatisfactory Performance / Misconduct: If the deployed manpower is found unfit, negligent, indisciplined, or unsatisfactory in performance, t he Buyer (office) has the right to demand immediate removal. The Servic e Provider will replace the person within 48 hours at no additional cost to t he Buyer. 17.2. Delay in providing a replacement may attract penalty deductions f rom the service charges or payments. The quantum of recovery will be decided by Officer In-charge. 18. Extension of Contract: Extension of the contract will be at the sole dir ection of buyer and would be subject to rendering of satisfactory performance d uring the period of the contract. If extension is granted, the scope of work, term s and conditions and rate would remain unchanged for the period of extension. 19. Liquidated Damages: In the event of the Seller's failure to submit the Bonds. Guarantees and Documents, supply the services etc as specified in this contract, the Buyer may, at his discretion, withhold any payment until the comp letion of the contract. The BUYER may also deduct from the SELLER as agreed, liquidated damages to the sum of 0.5% of the contract price of the delayed/und elivered stores/services mentioned above for every week of delay or part of a w eek, subject to the maximum value of the Liquidated Damages being not higher

than 10% of the value of delayed stores. 20. The minimum contract rates shall be based on existing Minimum Wages promulgated by the Chief Labour Commissioner (C) for the concerned area and will be subject to revision of minimum wages by said office for the concerned ar ea for which intimation letter shall be submitted by the contractor along with co py of applicable order to this effect. The payment to the contractor will be enha nced in accordance with revised minimum wages after approval of competent a uthority. It shall be the responsibility of the contractor to obtain the current mini mum wages as and when revised by Chief Labour Commissioner (C) and intimat e the CO about the payment of the same. 21. Penalty & Expense Clause: In case the contractor fails to carry out on any day, any of the work mentioned in scope of works, falls short in providing requisite manpower, on account of such breach, pro rata rec overy through Risk & Expense along with penalty equal to 2% of the to tal monthly charges every day of contract. The quantum of recovery will b e decided by Officer In-charge. 21.1. The buyer will have the right to make good any shortfall in services of the contractor at his risk and cost of hiring manpower. In addition to de duction of penalty mentioned above from the monthly bill of the firm or fr om the PBG submitted by the firm. 21.2. In case of contractor failing to arrange proper uniform as specified f or the employees employed inside the Office or failing to make payment w ithin stipulated time i e. by 7th of the month contract will be terminated. 21.3. The buyer shall be entitled to deduct from the pending bills of the co ntractor all such sums of money as may be claimed by the Government in terms of herein mentioned clauses of this arrangement. Any sum of mone y not covered by the amount of the said bills is liable to be deducted from the Performance Bank Guarantee/ Security Deposit of the firm. 22. Revision of Minimum Wages: The minimum contract rates shall be b ased on existing Minimum Wages promulgated by the Chief Labour Commission er for concerned area and will be subject to revision of minimum wages by said office for concerned area for which intimation letter shall be submitted by the c ontractor along with copy of applicable order to this effect. The payment to the contractor will be enhanced in accordance with revised minimum wages after a pproval of competent authority. It shall be responsibility of the contractor to obt ain current minimum wages as and when revised by the Chief Labour Commissi oner. However, the service charges quoted by the bidder will be fixed and will n ot be subject to any change. 23.
